located.notFound: It points at the first line of {{definition}}, because the target's own line there was not found.

strictMemorySafetyMissing.text: {{target}} does not compile under strict memory safety. Add .strictMemorySafety() to its swiftSettings, so every unsafe construct is visible where it is used; then replace each flagged site with a safe API where one exists, and mark unsafe only what must be.

strictMemorySafetyMissingInXcode.text: {{target}} does not compile under strict memory safety<<configurations>>. Set the target's SWIFT_STRICT_MEMORY_SAFETY build setting to YES in every configuration, so every unsafe construct is visible where it is used; then replace each flagged site with a safe API where one exists, and mark unsafe only what must be.<<located>>
